subject: maths
question: What annual installment will discharge a debt of ₹5,460 due in 5 years at 10% simple interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Total debt = ₹5,460

Time = 5 years

Rate of interest = 10% per annum

**Formula used:**

Total Debt = P × (1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) + P × 0.1 × (4 + 3 + 2 + 1)

**Calculation:**

Total Debt = 5P + 0.1P × 10 = 6P

⇒ 6P = 5460

⇒ P = 5460 / 6 = 910

**∴ The annual installment is ₹910.**
